purpose: Bind the trader-confirmed distinction between ordinary momentum, true displacement, rejection-trigger sequences, normal post-break continuation, weak-break 15m continuation, the only two permitted pre-break early-entry families, the live intra-candle force clock, and the required second-5m extension beyond the first completed breakout candle before a normal breakout entry.

momentum_vs_displacement.momentum_candle: Directional body/control geometry using the existing frozen Params.body_frac and Params.close_loc. Range expansion is NOT required.
momentum_vs_displacement.displacement: Momentum plus true range expansion using the existing frozen Params.range_ratio. Every strong bullish/red momentum candle is not displacement.

timeframe_hierarchy.one_minute_role: Causal sub-bars reconstruct the forming 5m parent candle and sustained force path; 1m candlestick pattern names do not replace 5m pattern identity.
timeframe_hierarchy.fifteen_minute_role: Higher-timeframe context and the already-frozen weak-break three-bar continuation family. The 15m chart may reveal that several 5m bars compose a larger rejection, but it is not a mandatory wait condition for a valid normal 5m breakout continuation.
timeframe_hierarchy.reason: The trader explicitly stated that depending on 15m confirmation can make the entry miss the move when the second 5m candle is already proving real continuation past the first breakout candle.

live_force_equation.why: The trader watches the forming candle like a buyer/seller tug of war and may enter before the parent candle closes once force is sustained. Waiting for the full 5m close can be materially late relative to the frozen 17.25-point stop and can consume normal pullback room.
live_force_equation.live_resolution: SAME_CAUSAL_DECISION_CLOCK_FOR_PARITY; no final parent-candle OHLC may authorize an earlier historical entry
live_force_equation.equation: FORCE = PARTIAL_MOMENTUM_GEOMETRY AND PATH_EFFICIENCY >= Params.body_frac AND LATEST_CLOSE_AT_DIRECTIONAL_EXTREME AND AT_LEAST_TWO_COMPLETED_1M_OBSERVATIONS AND PARENT_CANDLE_NOT_CLOSED
live_force_equation.partial_momentum_geometry: Aggregate only the completed 1m sub-bars known at the decision clock into the forming parent candle and apply the already-frozen Params.body_frac/Params.close_loc geometry.
live_force_equation.tug_of_war: Large giveback/back-and-forth increases path distance without equal directional progress and therefore lowers efficiency.
live_force_equation.directional_extreme: For longs, latest completed 1m close must equal/regain the strongest completed 1m close so far; shorts are the mirror image.
live_force_equation.minimum_observation_reason: Two completed sub-bars are the structural minimum needed to observe persistence versus giveback; this value was fixed from semantics before any clean performance result was observed and is not PnL-selected.
live_force_equation.parent_close_policy: If force was not proven before the parent candle close, that candle does not receive the trader's early momentum-entry privilege.

rejection_entry_family.trigger: completed rejection/control event followed by sustained live directional force in the forming trigger candle

normal_breakout_family.first_print_definition: A completed 5m candle closes beyond the exact key-level zone.
normal_breakout_family.entry_trigger: The immediately following forming 5m candle may trigger before its close only after sustained intra-5m force is causally proven AND it pushes beyond the first completed breakout candle's directional extreme while remaining beyond the broken zone.
normal_breakout_family.long_extension_requirement: forming second 5m trades above the first breakout candle high
normal_breakout_family.short_extension_requirement: forming second 5m trades below the first breakout candle low
normal_breakout_family.why_extension_is_required: Taking out the first breakout candle's extreme is part of proving the second candle has real continuation force/momentum. Merely being green/red or remaining beyond the key level is not safe enough.

weak_break_three_bar_continuation.weak_break_definition: The first completed breakout candle closes beyond the exact zone but does not meet the frozen momentum-candle geometry.
weak_break_three_bar_continuation.strong_first_break_behavior: Do not arm the weak-break 15m path; wait for the normal following 5m momentum/force confirmation with directional extension beyond the first breakout candle.
sequence: BAR1: completed weak candle establishes the break beyond the exact key zone
BAR2: completed controlled pullback toward the broken level without invalidating through the opposite side
BAR3: while forming, sustained directional force may trigger before the 15m close once continuation is causally proven
weak_break_three_bar_continuation.use_case: When the initial break is weak and the immediate normal 5m continuation is not earned, price may pull back and the trader checks the 15-minute chart for the three-bar continuation. Do not require waiting for bar 3 to close if force is already sustained.

families.name: REPEAT_TEST_MOMENTUM_ATTACK
families.rule: The key level has already been tested, at least one completed bar resets away so this is a distinct test rather than adjacent bars sitting on the level, then price returns for another test/attack. The forming attack candle may trigger before close only after sustained intra-5m directional force is proven.

families.name: DISPLACEMENT_SEQUENCE_INTO_LEVEL
families.rule: A genuine displacement drive heads directly toward the key zone. At least one of the first two drive candles must be true displacement; the other may be ordinary directional momentum because every strong candle is not displacement. The THIRD candle is the timing candle and may trigger before its close only after sustained directional force is proven while price is close to the authorized key level. If the third candle loses/reverses control, no early entry.
families.note: A three-candle sequence may incidentally form an FVG, but the trader does not use FVG formation to authorize this entry. The rule is about the third candle of the displacement drive sustaining real force near the key level.

range_day_key_zone_room.rule: When the causal pre-open structure is ranging/mixed, do not authorize key zones crowded against or inside the active range. Preserve meaningful nearby structure as reaction/target context, but fresh entry-authorized zones should leave breakout travel room from the range edge before price reaches the key zone.
range_day_key_zone_room.range_classifier: existing causal premarket plan pm_structure == MIXED

target_rule_reconfirmed.rule: First meaningful reaction area in physical trade direction owns TP. Liquidity cluster before FVG -> liquidity cluster wins. FVG before liquidity cluster -> FVG wins.
